notes.title: Ver.1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Ver.1.02 Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Slightly adjusted the visuals in Course 302 for a smoother experience.
[*] Increased the falling speed in Normal Mode of Course 303 to improve game balance. 
[*] Fixed part of the course layout in Course 303 to enhance playability. 
[*] Corrected some collision detection issues in Course 401 to resolve hitbox problems.
[*] Added 4 hidden items, "PopcornShrimp," to the EX Mode of Course 401, increasing exploration fun.
[/list]

notes.title: BUNNY DEMO Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354636/899dc62a1e4d032658a1f179f3be973ccea6cd87.jpg[/img]With the BUNNY demo, you can be among the first to experience Course 1.
Jump in and enjoy this exciting new adventure!

notes.title: Ver.1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a Quit button to the Title screen to allow exiting the game.
[*] Changed the Pause screen so that pressing the ESC key or the Gamepad’s FaceButtonTop returns to the Title screen.
[*] Reduced the processing load of Course401.
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: BUNNY ON SALE April 18, 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354636/bb82d4fe8cd762961d0df701143c7d3f05ad4bd8.png[/img]

After countless nights and early mornings, the game I've been crafting bit by bit in my private time is finally complete! On April 18, 2025, I'll hit that release button. It's a tiny project, but somehow three whole years slipped by in the process 😄

notes.title: OMG! 💖 BUNNY is Featured on INDIE Live Expo 2025!

notes.title: Setsubun
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354636/1079d37de1dbf0e95fc17364d2b1fd96ac7f771d.gif[/img]

Setsubun is a traditional Japanese event held on February 3rd to celebrate the change of seasons. During this day, people perform a unique ritual of eating 'ehōmaki', a special sushi roll.

Eat lots of sushi rolls with BUNNY!!
